command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; $branch=(git branch --show-current).Trim(); if($branch -ne 'main'){throw "Expected main, found $branch"}; $dirty=@(git status --porcelain); if($dirty.Count -ne 0){$dirty|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_}; throw 'Refusing to fast-forward dirty checkout'}; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'SYNCED_HEAD'; git rev-parse HEAD; Write-Output 'SYNCED_STATUS'; git status --short
